title: editor : `TouchScreenButton` not working in custom editor main menu which is added via `EditorInterface` singleton
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible in: v4.6.dev5.official [f5918a9d3]

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev5 - Android 11 (SDK 30 build V13.0.16.0.RGFMIXM) - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3 (Compatibility) - Mali-G52 -  (8 threads)

### Issue description

in the custom editor main menu which is added via `EditorInterface` singleton, `TouchScreenButton` nodes are not working.

if they are clicked, they just do nothing, regardless of whether `emulate touch from mouse` option is enabled or not.

i do expected it to work, the same as it's expected behavior at runtime.

### Steps to reproduce

- import the given godot project.
- the editor should show an "a" tab next to play button.
- select the "a" tab, and it will show a `PlaceholderTexture2D` texture which is covered with a blue collision shape, that's `TouchScreenButton` .
- now, try to hold it.
-- if it prints message in console, it works.
-- if it doesn't do anything, it don't work.
